entries.zh: §L“今天的工地，建造明天的文明”§!
entries.en: §L'Today, a construction site. Tomorrow, a civilization.'§!
Use a £colony_ship£ ['concept_colony_ship'] to colonize a habitable £planet£ ['concept_planet'].

entries.zh: §L“新星球不只是国之大是，更是一种义不容辞的责任。”——《殖民操作手册——第223版》§!
entries.en: §L'A new world is not merely an asset; it is a responsibility.' - Colonial Operations Handbook, 223rd Edition§!
Use a £construction_ship£ ['concept_construction_ship'] to build a £mining_station£ ['concept_mining_station'] above a suitable ['concept_celestial_object'].

entries.zh: §L“许多人只看到小行星。而在我们眼里那只是一坨形状不便的钱。”§!
entries.en: §L'Some see an asteroid. We see an inconveniently shaped pile of credits.'§!

entries.zh: §L“智者行旅，不壅川流。饮其甘泉，盈其行囊，复踏征途。”§!
entries.en: §L'The wise traveler does not dam the river. They drink, fill their stores, and continue on their way.'§!

entries.zh: 在一个非首都殖民地上前往£interface£['concept_colony_view']的$colony_view_tab_planet_summary$选项卡并改变['concept_designation']。
entries.en: In a non-Capital colony, go to the $colony_view_tab_planet_summary$ tab of the £interface£ ['concept_colony_view'] and change the ['concept_designation'].

entries.zh: §L“官方点说，殖民地规划可以提升效率。但不幸的是，这只是一种让‘看着办’变得像是什么经济策略的说法。”§!
entries.en: §L'Officially, colony designations improve efficiency. Unofficially, they're just a way to make 'mostly rocks' sound like an economic strategy.'§!

entries.zh: §L“每块甲板都各有其职，而把分工写清楚能让分工更加显著。”§!
entries.en: §L'Every deck has a purpose. Naming that purpose just makes it harder to ignore.'§!

entries.zh: §L“他们承诺了冒险，却未提及数月的沉寂与循环的空气。直到贸易中心上线——终于，有了值得留驻的理由。”§!
entries.en: §L'They promised adventure. They didn't mention the months of silence and recycled air. Then the Trade Hub came online - finally, something worth sticking around for.'§!

entries.zh: §L“星系中的位置决定恒星基地的功能；而建筑进一步将其精细化。”— 《轨道工程学：理论与应用》§!
entries.en: §L'Galactic positioning defines a starbase's function; a building refines it.' - Orbital Engineering: Theory and Application§!

entries.en: In the $society_management_view_tab_traditions$ tab of the £interface£ ['concept_society_management_view'], adopt a ['concept_tradition'].

entries.zh: §L“无传统不可明志，尽循教踌躇不前。一切智慧尽在择路而前。”§!
entries.en: §L'People without tradition are aimless. Those bound by tradition stagnate. Wisdom lies in choosing which to carry forward.'§!
In the §H$government_view_tab_policies_and_edicts$§! tab of the £interface£ ['concept_government_view'], activate an ['concept_edict'].

entries.zh: §L“各位公民：827-B法令已经正式生效。详情请见第34页第12小节。祝你今天工作顺利！”§!
entries.en: §L'Attention citizens: Edict 827-B has been officially enacted. See paragraph 34, subsection 12, for full compliance guidelines. Have a productive day!'§!

entries.zh: 当['concept_agenda']完成时，在£interface£['concept_government_view']的$government_view_tab_council$选项卡将其发布并选择一项新的。

entries.zh: §L“统治者没有议程如同星舰没有航线。”§!
entries.en: §L'A ruler without an agenda is like a starship without a course.'§!

entries.zh: 收集£energy£['concept_energy']需要在£interface£['concept_colony_view']的$colony_view_tab_planet_summary$选项卡建造£district£['concept_generator_districts']。\n\n或者可以在蕴含能量的['concept_celestial_objects']建造£mining_station£['concept_mining_stations']、在£market£['concept_market']或向其他['concept_empires']购买£energy£§H$concept_energy$§!。$focus_other$

entries.zh: §L“能量币买不来快乐，但是贸易可以！”§!
entries.en: §L'Credits can't buy happiness, but trade might!'§!

entries.zh: 花费£operational_reserves£['concept_operational_reserves']，需要将§H局势应对方案§!设置为§H$situation_nomad_economy_full_spending$§!，且不让£arkship£ ['concept_arkship']或者£construction_ship£ ['concept_logistic_ship']使用['scripted_action:arkship_harvest_resources']。$focus_other$

entries.zh: §L“应用尽用。只要知道哪里有沃土，离下一次丰收就绝对不会远。”§!
entries.en: §L'Spend freely. The next harvest is never far when you know where to look.'§!

entries.zh: 收集£minerals£['concept_minerals']需要在£interface£['concept_colony_view']的$colony_view_tab_planet_summary$选项卡建造£district£['concept_mining_districts']。\n\n或者可以在蕴含矿物的['concept_celestial_objects']建造£mining_station£['concept_mining_stations']、在£market£['concept_market']或向其他['concept_empires']购买£minerals£§H$concept_minerals$§!。$focus_other$

entries.zh: §L“呼吸过深会得尘肺，呼吸过浅就会憋死。不用担心医疗费，公司会直接从你工资里扣的。”§!
entries.en: §L'Breathe too deep, you get silicate lung. Breathe too shallow, you pass out. Either way, the company docks your pay.'§!

entries.zh: 要提升£operational_reserves£['concept_operational_reserves']，可以让£arkship£ ['concept_arkship']或£construction_ship£['concept_logistic_ship']使用['scripted_action:arkship_harvest_resources']功能。\n\n或者，在£market£ ['concept_market']购买£energy£§H$concept_energy$§!或£minerals£§H$concept_minerals$§!。$focus_other$
entries.en: To increase £operational_reserves£ ['concept_operational_reserves'], use ['scripted_action:arkship_harvest_resources'] with an £arkship£ ['concept_arkship'] or £construction_ship£ ['concept_logistic_ship'].\n\nAlternatively, buy £energy£ §H$concept_energy$§! or £minerals£ §H$concept_minerals$§! on the £market£ ['concept_market'].$focus_other$

entries.zh: §L“有句老军需官的话说：今天的余应得了明天的急。”§!
entries.en: §L'The old quartermasters had a saying: surplus now is tomorrow's emergency fund.'§!

entries.zh: 收集£food£['concept_food']需要在£interface£['concept_colony_view']的$colony_view_tab_planet_summary$选项卡建造£district£['concept_farming_districts']。\n\n或者可以在£market£['concept_market']或向其他['concept_empires']购买£food£§H$concept_food$§!。$focus_other$

entries.zh: §L“仓廪足则国富强。连肚子都填不饱，国也很快就将不国了。”§!
entries.en: §L'A well-fed empire is a strong empire. A starving empire is a soon-to-be someone else's empire.'§!

entries.zh: 收集£food£['concept_food']需要在£interface£['concept_colony_view']的$colony_view_tab_planet_summary$选项卡建造£district£['concept_farming_districts']。\n\n或者可以在£market£['concept_market']或向其他['concept_empires']购买£food£§H$concept_food$§!。$focus_other$

entries.zh: §L“跑得快也要吃得好，下一颗恒星可远没有看起来那么近。”§!
entries.en: §L'A people in motion must eat well, for the next star is always further than it seems.'§!

entries.zh: 收集£consumer_goods£['concept_consumer_goods']需要在£interface£['concept_colony_view']的$colony_view_tab_planet_summary$选项卡建造£district£['concept_industrial_districts']、在£market£['concept_market']或向其他['concept_empires']购买£consumer_goods£§H$concept_consumer_goods$§!。$focus_other$

entries.zh: §L消费品助力创新、提升文化、满足大众需求。具体是什么呢？奢侈品？高级工具？还是一顶漂亮的帽子？都是。”§!
entries.en: §L'Consumer Goods fuel innovation, culture, and general contentment. Are they luxury items? Advanced tools? A really nice hat? Yes.'§!

entries.zh: 想收集£consumer_goods£ ['concept_consumer_goods']，需要在£interface£ ['concept_colony_view']的$colony_view_tab_planet_summary$选项卡建造£district£ ['concept_industrial_districts']、在£market£ ['concept_market']或向其他['concept_empires']购买£consumer_goods£ §H$concept_consumer_goods$§!。$focus_other$

entries.zh: §L“在方舟之上，每条丝线、电路，乃至安逸之享都有两次生命：第一次在产生之时，第二次在维护之中。”§!
entries.en: §L'The Arkship demands that every thread, circuit, and comfort be earned twice: once in the making, and once in the keeping.'§!

entries.zh: §L“合金也许不是最迷人的资源，但试试出于好意建造一艘战舰吧。”§!
entries.en: §L'Alloys may not be the most glamorous resource, but try building a battleship out of good intentions.'§!

entries.zh: §L“再加点隧道，再加点工蜂，再加点蜂巢，什么都再加点。”§!
entries.en: §L'More tunnels. More drones. More hive. Always more.'§!

entries.zh: §L“城市天际线是人民雄心的衡量单位。建得越高，他们就畅想得越远。”§!
entries.en: §L'A skyline is the measure of its people's ambition. The higher we build, the further they dream.'§!
Build a £district£ §H$district_ark_city$ District§! in the $colony_view_tab_planet_summary$ tab of the £interface£ ['concept_colony_view'].

entries.zh: §L“引擎承载我们前行。市场与集会厅提醒我们为何而奋斗。” ——方舟舰箴言§!
entries.en: §L'The engines carry us forward. The markets and the meeting halls remind us why we bother.' - Arkship proverb§!

entries.zh: §L“枢纽区划越多意味着单元越多。除非发现反常否则没有不利之处。此时就需要重新校准。”§!
entries.en: §L'More Nexus Districts mean more Units. There is no downside. Unless deviancy is detected. Then there is recalibration.'§!

entries.zh: §L“还有什么比工业雾霾更能说明经济发展吗？”§!
entries.en: §L'Nothing says progress like a good industrial haze.'§!
Build a £district£ ['concept_generator_district'] in the $colony_view_tab_planet_summary$ tab of the £interface£ ['concept_colony_view'].

entries.zh: §L“能量是一切事物运动的媒介。”——阿布德巴尔§!
entries.en: §L'Energy is the medium through which all things manifest.' - The Abdbaal§!

entries.zh: §L“如你我饮水一般，星球以光为饮。”——佐西拉·科顿§!
entries.en: §L'The World drank light, like you or I might drink water.'- Zosira K'Tun§!

entries.en: Build a £district£ §H$district_ark_generator$ District§! in the $colony_view_tab_planet_summary$ tab of the £interface£ ['concept_colony_view'].

entries.zh: §L“下层船体日夜轰鸣。久而久之，反而是寂静才令人恐惧。”§!
entries.en: §L'The lower hull hums day and night. After a while, silence is the thing that frightens you.'§!
Build a £district£ ['concept_mining_district'] in the $colony_view_tab_planet_summary$ tab of the £interface£ ['concept_colony_view'].

entries.zh: §L“星球的财富并不在空中，而是深埋土里。深挖洞广开矿，财富随之而来。”§!
entries.en: §L'The wealth of a world is not in its skies, but in its dirt. Dig deep, and prosperity will follow.'§!

entries.zh: 在£interface£['concept_colony_view']的$colony_view_tab_planet_summary$选项卡建造一座£district£§H中空山岭§!。
entries.en: Build a £district£ §HHollow Mountain§! in the $colony_view_tab_planet_summary$ tab of the £interface£ ['concept_colony_view'].

entries.zh: §L“山之巍巍然如林木，亦可萃内蕴之灵气。“§!
entries.en: §L'A mountain, much like a tree, can be tapped for the mana within.'§!

entries.zh: §L“定居文明将军队与城市分开。而我们的家园就是我们的武器。”§!
entries.en: §L'Settled folk keep their armies and their cities separate. Our home is our weapon.'§!
Build a £district£ §H$district_ark_forever_cruise$§! in the $colony_view_tab_planet_summary$ tab of the £interface£ ['concept_colony_view'].
§L'The passengers see the chandelier. The crew sees the wiring.'§!
Build an £district£ ['concept_farming_district'] in the $colony_view_tab_planet_summary$ tab of the £interface£ ['concept_colony_view'].

entries.zh: §L“第一个收获者也许贫弱不堪。但当新收的谷物接触到舌头，我们第一次知晓这个星球是可以养活我们的。”§!
entries.en: §L'The first harvest was meagre. But as the new grain touched our tongues, we knew this world would sustain us.'§!

entries.zh: §L“听说行星居民让食物种在露天的泥里，晒着不过滤的恒星光。这也太粗糙了。”§!
entries.en: §L'They say that planet-dwellers let food grow in open dirt, under an unfiltered star. Seems reckless.'§!

entries.zh: §L“殖民者们喜欢坚决的领导——直到哪个决议他们不喜欢为止。”§!
entries.en: §L'Colonists love decisive leadership - right up until they disagree with the decision.'§!

entries.en: §L'Today, it's a branch office. Tomorrow, it's the backbone of their economy.' - Executive Ytella Cixi'dolf, Expansion Division§!

entries.zh: §L“最先签约，最快履约：我们心口如一，言出必行。”§!
entries.en: §L'First contract, first proof: we do what we say, and we say what we mean.'§!

entries.zh: 完成£interface£ ['concept_situation_log_view']的$situation_log_view_tab_situation_log$选项卡中列出的§H方舟舰整备§!事项。
entries.en: Complete the §HArkship Readiness§! issues listed in the $situation_log_view_tab_situation_log$ tab of the £interface£ ['concept_situation_log_view'].

entries.zh: §L“敬那些找我们麻烦之前就被我们找到的麻烦！”——佚名，刻在7号维修舱§!
entries.en: §L'To the faults we found before they found us!' - Anonymous, scratched into Maintenance Bay 7§!
Accept £contract£ ['concept_contracts'] on the £interface£ ['concept_galaxy_map'] and complete the tasks.

entries.zh: §L“一次言出必行是承诺。每次言出必行则是声誉。”§!
entries.en: §L'Proof once is a promise. Proof repeated is a reputation.'§!
Accept £contract£ ['concept_contracts'] on the £interface£ ['concept_galaxy_map'] and complete the tasks.

entries.zh: §L“去跟我们打过交道的那些港口、空间站和帝国打听打听，他们都会说：办事麻利，按时守约。”§!
entries.en: §L'Ask any port, any station, any empire who dealt with us: the work was done, on time, as agreed.'§!
Accept £contract£ ['concept_contracts'] on the £interface£ ['concept_galaxy_map'] and complete the tasks.

entries.zh: §L“帝国会有兴亡更替。但声望若得之有道，则能万古长存。”§!
entries.en: §L'Empires rise and fall. Reputations, if earned properly, outlast them all.'§!

entries.zh: 发现£anomaly£['concept_anomaly']后，指派一位£scientist£['concept_scientist']进行全面调查。
entries.en: After discovering an £anomaly£ ['concept_anomaly'], assign a £scientist£ ['concept_scientist'] to fully investigate it.

entries.zh: §L“没有什么所谓的正常信号。每个闪烁，每个回声都有意义。唯一的问题是，意义是什么。”§!
entries.en: §L'There is no such thing as an ordinary signal. Every flicker, every echo means something. The only question is what.'§!
Use a £science_ship£ ['concept_science_ship'] to fully survey a new £system£ ['concept_system'].

entries.zh: §L“如果对想要宣称的恒星没有全面的了解，扩张就无法进行。”——《星系测绘学入门》第七版§!
entries.en: §L'No expansion can proceed without first understanding the stars we seek to claim.' - Introduction to Stellar Cartography, 7th Edition§!

entries.zh: 在£interface£['concept_situation_log_view']的$situation_log_view_tab_situation_log$选项卡，找到一个['concept_special_project']并进行研究。
entries.en: In the $situation_log_view_tab_situation_log$ tab of the £interface£ ['concept_situation_log_view'], find a ['concept_special_project'] and research it.

entries.zh: §L“你可能以为理解数据这个部分很难。错了，难的是让人相信我们研究的东西有半点用。”§!
entries.en: §L'You think the hard part is making sense of the data. No, the hard part is convincing people that what we found actually matters.'§!

entries.zh: 用£science_ship£['concept_science_ship']探索新£system£['concept_systems']直到找到外星生命。
entries.en: Use a £science_ship£ ['concept_science_ship'] to survey new £system£ ['concept_systems'] until alien life is found.

entries.zh: §L“搜寻外星生命不是在问有没有，而是问什么时候找到。当找到的时候又要问：我们真能认出来它们是什么东西吗？”§!
entries.en: §L'The search for alien life is not a question of if, but when. And when we find it, we must ask: will we recognize it for what it is?'§!

entries.zh: 调查£anomaly£['concept_anomalies']、£archaeology£['concept_archaeology_site']以及太空战斗的['concept_debris']。有些可能给予在研究完成之前一直可选的§H永久研究选项§!。
entries.en: Investigate £anomaly£ ['concept_anomalies'], £archaeology£ ['concept_archaeology_site'], and ['concept_debris'] from space battles. Some may grant a §HPermanent Research Option§! that remains available until researched.

entries.zh: §L“真正的进展从来不是飞跃——而是无数谨慎踏向未知的脚步。”——《科学探索原则》第三卷§!
entries.en: §L'True progress is never a leap - it is a thousand careful steps into the unknown.' - Principles of Scientific Inquiry, Vol. III§!
In the £interface£ ['concept_leaders_view'], hire a ['concept_leader'] of the £scientist£ ['concept_scientist'] class.$focus_other$

entries.zh: §L“什么，你想要个既会测绘量子奇点又会控制预算的？那祝你好运吧。”§!
entries.en: §L'You want someone who can chart both a quantum singularity and a budget? Good luck with that.'§!

entries.zh: 指派£scientist£['concept_scientist']到一个£archaeology£['concept_archaeology_site']并引导其完成事件链。
entries.en: Assign a £scientist£ ['concept_scientist'] to an £archaeology£ ['concept_archaeology_site'] and guide them through the events.

entries.zh: §L“又一个古代帝国，又一个前车之鉴。你认为现在有人会吸取教训吗。”§!
entries.en: §L'Another ancient empire, another ominous warning. You'd think someone would have learned by now.'§!

entries.zh: 已完成一处考古遗址发掘

指派有£scientist£['concept_scientist']指挥的£science_ship£['concept_science_ship']调查£system£['concept_systems']、研究£anomaly£['concept_anomalies']。也可以指派其作为['concept_governor']或作为['concept_council']。\n\n每项任务都可以提供宝贵的经验值，使其等级提升并发展出新['concept_leader_traits']。
entries.en: Assign a £science_ship£ ['concept_science_ship'] led by a £scientist£ ['concept_scientist'] to survey £system£ ['concept_systems'] and investigate £anomaly£ ['concept_anomalies']. Alternatively, assign them as a ['concept_governor'] or to the ['concept_council'].\n\nSuch duties provide valuable experience, allowing them to level up and develop new ['concept_leader_traits'].

entries.zh: §L“知识不目标，而是桥梁——只有当我们敢于踏上去的那一刻，它才会往前延伸。”——《学者之路：理解带来成长》§!
entries.en: §L'Knowledge is not a destination, but a bridge - one that extends only when we dare to cross it.' - The Scholar's Path: Growth Through Understanding§!

entries.zh: 用£construction_ship£['concept_construction_ship']在一颗有§H前超光速文明§!的行星上建造§H观测站§!。
entries.en: Use a £construction_ship£ ['concept_construction_ship'] to build a §HObservation Post§! above a planet with a §HPre-FTL Civilization§!.

entries.zh: §L“这些人们在实现超光速之前把自己炸平的概率是三分之一。买定离手。”§!
entries.en: §L'Current odds on these people blowing themselves up before achieving FTL is 3 to 1. Place your bets.'§!

entries.zh: 在£interface£['concept_colony_view']的$colony_view_tab_planet_summary$选项卡或者£interface£['concept_planets_and_sector_view']中，指派一位£scientist£['concept_scientist']作为一个£sector£['concept_sector']或£planet£['concept_planet']的['concept_governor']。
entries.en: In either the $colony_view_tab_planet_summary$ tab of the £interface£ ['concept_colony_view'] or in the £interface£ ['concept_planets_and_sector_view'], assign a £scientist£ ['concept_scientist'] as a ['concept_governor'] of a £sector£ ['concept_sector'] or £planet£ ['concept_planet'].

entries.zh: §L“科学不会为传统服务，也不会循规蹈矩。科学家管理的星球一定会充满勃勃生机。”——《领袖的回响》策展人罗沙•托什§!
entries.en: §L'Science does not serve tradition, nor does it obey the past. A world ruled by scientists will always be a world in motion.' - Curator Rhassa Tosh, Reflections on Leadership§!

entries.zh: 已指派一名科学官为总督
entries.en: Has assigned a Scientist as governor

entries.zh: 在研究£physics£§H$tech_wormhole_stabilization$§!科技后，指派£science_ship£['concept_science_ship']探索并穿越一个§H虫洞§!。
entries.en: After researching the £physics£ §H$tech_wormhole_stabilization$§! technology, assign a £science_ship£ ['concept_science_ship'] to explore, and then travel through a §HWormhole§!.

entries.zh: §L“注意，学院的人寿保险政策不能涵盖在时间旅行悖论中被抹除。”§!
entries.en: §L'Note that the institute's life insurance policy does not cover being erased from existence in a time-travel paradox.'§!

entries.zh: 在£interface£['concept_contacts_view']的$contacts_view_tab_contacts$选项卡，向另一个['concept_empire']提出该['concept_diplomatic_pact']。
entries.en: In the $contacts_view_tab_contacts$ tab of the £interface£ ['concept_contacts_view'], propose this ['concept_diplomatic_pact'] with another ['concept_empire'].

entries.zh: §L“两个人比一个人解题快。两个文明？联手起来能发现什么我都不敢想。”§!
entries.en: §L'Two minds can solve a problem faster than one. Two civilizations? There is no limit to what we may discover together.'§!

entries.zh: 在£interface£ ['concept_galaxy_map']接受一项§H$contract_deep_scan$§!合约，随后派遣一艘£arkship£ ['concept_arkship']在所示['concept_system']执行§H$arkship_deep_scan$§!舰队命令。
entries.en: Accept a §H$contract_deep_scan$§! contract on the £interface£ ['concept_galaxy_map'], then send an £arkship£ ['concept_arkship'] to perform the §H$arkship_deep_scan$§! fleet order in the indicated ['concept_system'].

entries.zh: §L“我们已经能够感知到最微弱的引力颤动、最遥远岩石发出的微弱哼唱。宇宙会回报那些用心观察的人。”§!
entries.en: §L'We have learned to read the faintest tremors of gravity, the softest hum of distant rock. The cosmos rewards those who pay attention.'§!

entries.zh: 在研究£physics£§H$tech_dyson_swarm$§!科技后，找到一颗合适的['concept_star']并用£construction_ship£['concept_construction_ship']建造§H$tech_dyson_swarm$§!£megastructure£['concept_megastructure']。
entries.en: After researching the £physics£ §H$tech_dyson_swarm$§! technology, find a suitable ['concept_star'] and use a £construction_ship£ ['concept_construction_ship'] to build the §H$tech_dyson_swarm$§! £megastructure£ ['concept_megastructure'].

entries.zh: §L“站在观测台前目睹第一座卫星徐徐展开……你会被深深改变的。能拥有恒星之光这件事实在令人陶醉。”ISS 迪•图玛号首席工程师提格•鲍里。§!
entries.en: §L'Standing on the observation deck, watching the first satellites unfold... It changes you. The idea that we could own the light of a star is intoxicating.' - Chief Engineer Tig Bori, ISS D'Tuma§!

entries.zh: 建成一座产出至少§Y30§!£physics£、£society£或£engineering£的戴森云
entries.en: Has built a Dyson Swarm producing at least §Y30§! £physics£, £society£, or £engineering£

entries.zh: 获得太空城邦研究支援
在建立通讯后，利用$concept_contacts_view$的$contacts_view_tab_contacts$选项卡向§H策展人城邦§!申请§H研究协助§!。
entries.en: After establishing contact, use the $contacts_view_tab_contacts$ tab of the $concept_contacts_view$ to request §HResearch Assistance§! the §HCurator Order§!.

entries.zh: §L“我曾经问策展人，有史以来最伟大的科学发现是哪一个。他们只是笑笑，说：下一个。”§!
entries.en: §L'I once asked a Curator what the greatest scientific discovery of all time was. They just smiled and said, "The next one."'§!

entries.zh: 已拥有太空城邦研究支援
在£interface£['concept_colony_view']的$colony_view_tab_planet_summary$选项卡，在一个或多个£colony£['concept_colonies']建造五座$building_research_lab_1$。
entries.en: In the $colony_view_tab_planet_summary$ tab of the £interface£ ['concept_colony_view'], build five $building_research_lab_1$ on one or more £colony£ ['concept_colonies'].

entries.zh: §L“也就建了五座科研实验室，然后我们就不知道给我们的预算都上哪去了。”§!
entries.en: §L'Five new research labs, and somehow we still don't know where the grant money goes.'§!

entries.zh: 在研究£physics£§H$tech_rift_sphere$§!科技后，指派£scientist£['concept_scientist']到一处['concept_astral_rift']并引导其完成事件链。
entries.en: After researching the £physics£ §H$tech_rift_sphere$§! technology, assign a £scientist£ ['concept_scientist'] to an ['concept_astral_rift'] and guide them through it.

entries.zh: §L“它违背物理、击碎时间，也许还会把我们的存在抹除。但我们理所应当地应该戳戳它。”§!
entries.en: §L'It defies physics, breaks time, and might erase us from existence. Naturally, we had to poke it.'§!

entries.zh: §L“真的科学家积累的才不是知识，而是洞见。”§!
entries.en: §L'A true scientist does not accumulate knowledge; they cultivate perspective.'§!

entries.zh: 在研究£society£§H$tech_terrestrial_sculpting$§!科技后，找到一颗适合['concept_terraforming']的£planet£['concept_planet']并开始该流程。
entries.en: After researching the £society£ §H$tech_terrestrial_sculpting$§! technology, find a £planet£ ['concept_planet'] suitable for ['concept_terraforming'] and start the process.

entries.zh: §L“你读了最近这段环境改造循环的更新日志了吗？他们新增了海滩耶！”§!
entries.en: §L'Have you read the changelog on the latest terraforming cycle? They added beaches!'§!

entries.zh: 在£interface£['concept_technology_view']，找到一项用特殊图标边框表示的§H循环科技§!并进行研究。
entries.en: In the £interface£ ['concept_technology_view'], find and research a §HRepeatable Technology§!, indicated by the special icon border.

entries.zh: §L“另一个突破，另一步向前。但地平线？它不会靠近一丝。”——首席科学家艾里•康托§!
entries.en: §L'Another breakthrough, another step forward. But the horizon? It never gets any closer.' - Chief Researcher Ely Canto§!

entries.zh: §L“看啊，这就是历史的壮美。如果我们可以搞明白它们的用法……”§!
entries.en: §L'Behold, the grandeur of the ancients! Now if we can just figure out how it works...'§!

entries.zh: 在一场与['concept_fallen_empire']的太空战斗后，派遣一艘£science_ship£['concept_science_ship']调查['concept_special_project']。
entries.en: Following a space battle with a ['concept_fallen_empire'], send a £science_ship£ ['concept_science_ship'] to investigate the ['concept_special_project'].

entries.zh: §L“人们在思考古代传奇时，常常会问：覆国者，其伟力也？其自身也？”——《破碎之冠：星系陷落研究》§!
entries.en: §L'When considering the legacy of the ancients, one must ask: did they fall because of their power, or in spite of it?' - Shattered Crowns: A Study of Galactic Decline§!

entries.zh: 在一场与§H危机§!的太空战斗后，派遣一艘£science_ship£['concept_science_ship']调查['concept_special_project']。
entries.en: Following a space battle with a §HCrisis§!, send a £science_ship£ ['concept_science_ship'] to investigate the ['concept_special_project'].

entries.zh: §L“理解一种武器是操作它的第一步。问题只在你能不能三思而后行。”——《权力的规模效应》哈斯克•瓦尔甘司令§!
entries.en: §L'To understand a weapon is one step closer to wielding it. The question is whether one can ever step back.' - Admiral Hask'Valgam, On the Scales of Power§!

entries.zh: §L“三位科学家，三种理论，以及任意两个人无法理解第三个在说什么的三个理由。”§!
entries.en: §L'Three scientists, three theories, and three reasons why the other two have no idea what they're talking about.'§!

entries.zh: 要新建一艘§H$science_arkship_name$§!，选择一艘现有的£arkship£ ['concept_arkship']并点击§H建造巨型结构§!。在其中选择方舟舰规划类型进行建造。
entries.en: To build a new §H$science_arkship_name$§!, select an existing £arkship£ ['concept_arkship'] and click §HBuild Megastructure§!. From there, select the Arkship Class to build.

entries.zh: §L“把图书馆建造在星球上只会分崩离析，而我们建造在飞船上则可一日万里。在我们的好奇心耗尽之前，宇宙的奥秘将会被悉数揭开。”—— 李恩·托拉迪教授的方舟理学院毕业典礼演讲§!
entries.en: §L'They built libraries on worlds that crumbled. We built ours on an engine that never stops. The universe will run out of secrets before we run out of curiosity.' - Professor Lienn Toradi, commencement speech at the Arkship Academy of Sciences§!

entries.zh: 在研究£physics£§H$tech_mega_shipyard$§!科技之后，找到一颗合适的£planet£['concept_planet']或['concept_star']并派遣一艘£construction_ship£['concept_construction_ship']来建造§H$tech_mega_shipyard$§!£megastructure£['concept_megastructure']。
entries.en: After researching the £physics£ §H$tech_mega_shipyard$§! technology, find a suitable £planet£ ['concept_planet'] or ['concept_star'] and use a £construction_ship£ ['concept_construction_ship'] to build the §H$tech_mega_shipyard$§! £megastructure£ ['concept_megastructure'].

entries.zh: §L“这座枢纽建成后，只要是我们时代存在的解决方案，就再也没有什么达成不了的了。”§!
entries.en: §L'With this Nexus, no answer is beyond our reach, though they may be beyond our time.§!

entries.zh: 建造更多['building:building_research_lab_1']。在£interface£['concept_colony_view']的$colony_view_tab_planet_summary$选项卡，将['concept_designation']变更为§H$col_research$§!。$focus_other$
entries.en: Build more ['building:building_research_lab_1']. In the $colony_view_tab_planet_summary$ tab of the £interface£ ['concept_colony_view'], change the ['concept_designation'] to §H$col_research$§!.$focus_other$

entries.zh: §L“显然我们这个季度的‘创新产出’下降了。或许少开一些例会我们就能取得更多的突破。”§!
entries.en: §L'Apparently, our "innovation output" is down this quarter. Maybe if we had fewer status meetings, we'd make more breakthroughs.'§!

entries.zh: 在£interface£['concept_discoveries_view']的$discoveries_view_tab_relics$选项卡，激活一个或多个['concept_relics']共10次。
entries.en: In the $discoveries_view_tab_relics$ tab of the £interface£ ['concept_discoveries_view'], activate one or more ['concept_relics'] 10 times.

entries.zh: §L“这件遗珍的详细说明是在一个古老的电子论坛上发现的。激活它应该轻而易举。”§!
entries.en: §L'The full specification of the relic was found in an ancient electronic discussion board. Activating it should be trivial.'§!

entries.zh: 使用£science_ship£['concept_science_ship']来探索未知的£system£['concept_systems']，直到发现了一只星神兽。
entries.en: Use a £science_ship£ ['concept_science_ship'] to explore new £system£ ['concept_systems'] until a Leviathan is found.

entries.zh: §L“寻找星神兽是一项危险的任务。而一旦找到它，我们必须扪心自问：面对如此强大的力量，我们应当如何应对？”§!
entries.en: §L'The search for a Leviathan is a dangerous undertaking. And once we find it, we must ask: what shall we do in the face of such power?'§!
In the £interface£ ['concept_leaders_view'], hire a recruitable ['concept_leader'] of the £commander£ ['concept_commander'] class.$focus_other$

entries.zh: §L“最好的指挥官不问薪水。他们只关心还要多久才能打一仗。”§!
entries.en: §L'The best Commanders don't ask about salary. They ask how soon they'll see combat.'§!

entries.zh: 在£interface£['concept_starbase_view']的$starbase_view_tab_command$选项卡，将['concept_starbase']升级到下一个等级。
entries.en: In the $starbase_view_tab_command$ tab of the £interface£ ['concept_starbase_view'], upgrade the ['concept_starbase'] to the next tier.

entries.zh: §L“好的星港可以作为一种警示信息。我们可不是建了好看的——而是为了让人三思而后行。”§!
entries.en: §L'A good starport is a warning. We don't build for beauty - we build so they think twice.'§!

entries.zh: 在£interface£ ['concept_waystation_view']的$waystation_view_tab_waystation$选项卡，将£waystation£ ['concept_waystation']升级至下一等级。
entries.en: In the $waystation_view_tab_waystation$ tab of the £interface£ ['concept_waystation_view'], upgrade the £waystation£ ['concept_waystation'] to the next tier.

entries.zh: §L“我们在他人之地上建设，自由地索取恒星的赠与。”§!
entries.en: §L'We build where others claim, and take what the stars offer freely.'§!

entries.zh: 在£interface£['concept_fleet_management_view']的$fleet_management_view_tab_fleet_manager$选项卡或['concept_shipyard']中，建造五艘§H护卫舰§!。
entries.en: In either the $fleet_management_view_tab_fleet_manager$ tab of the £interface£ ['concept_fleet_management_view'] or a ['concept_shipyard'], build five §HCorvette§! ships.

entries.zh: §L“快速，廉价，可替代。没有人这么说出来，但所有的船员都心知肚明。”——第3远征舰队，伊尔什·那速塔§!
entries.en: §L'Fast, cheap, and replaceable. No one says it out loud, but the crews know.' - Ilsh na-Sutar, 3rd Expeditionary Fleet§!

entries.zh: 在£interface£['concept_fleet_management_view']的$fleet_management_view_tab_fleet_manager$选项卡或['concept_beastport']中，克隆五只太空变形虫。
entries.en: In either the $fleet_management_view_tab_fleet_manager$ tab of the £interface£ ['concept_fleet_management_view'] or a ['concept_beastport'], clone five Space Amoebas.

entries.zh: §L“将一个生命体塑造成一件武器……有人称之为进步，有人称之为亵渎。但是历史只会记住谁活了下来。”——《基因学与战争艺术》哈斯克·祖蒙博士§!
entries.en: §L'To take a living organism and mold it into a weapon... Some call it progress. Others, blasphemy. History will only remember who survived.' - Dr. Hask'Zumon, Genetics and the Art of War§!

entries.zh: 在£interface£['concept_fleet_management_view']的$fleet_management_view_tab_fleet_manager$选项卡或['concept_shipyard']中，建造五艘§H颚蚁§!生物舰船。
entries.en: In either the $fleet_management_view_tab_fleet_manager$ tab of the £interface£ ['concept_fleet_management_view'] or a ['concept_shipyard'], produce five biological §HMauler§! ships.

entries.zh: §L“颚蚁这个名字不是乱起的。”——娜拉·纳-特尔坎，第4远征舰队§!
entries.en: §L'We call them Maulers for a reason.' - Nara na-Telkan, 4th Expeditionary Fleet§!

entries.zh: 在£interface£['concept_starbase_view']的$starbase_view_tab_defenses$选项卡，建造3座§H防御平台§!。
entries.en: In the $starbase_view_tab_defenses$ tab of the £interface£ ['concept_starbase_view'], build three §HDefense Platforms§!.

entries.zh: §L“这些平台不是为了万世长存的，它们只为比另外一些东西活得更久而存在。”§!
entries.en: §L'They're not built to last. Just long enough to make someone else die first.'§!
In the $contacts_view_tab_contacts$ tab of the £interface£ ['concept_contacts_view'], declare another ['concept_empire'] a ['concept_rival'].

entries.zh: §L“帝国的伟大不是由有多少支持者决定的，而是由它宿敌的强大来定义。”§!
entries.en: §L'An empire's greatness is not measured by the number of its supporters, but by the strength of its rivals.'§!

entries.zh: 在$concept_fleet_management_view$的$fleet_management_view_tab_fleet_manager$选项卡，设计一支足够强大的['concept_fleet']。在£interface£['concept_outliner']、£interface£['concept_system_map']或£interface£['concept_galaxy_map']中选择该舰队，并将其派向战场。
entries.en: In the $fleet_management_view_tab_fleet_manager$ tab of the $concept_fleet_management_view$, design a strong enough ['concept_fleet']. Select the fleet in the £interface£ ['concept_outliner'], £interface£ ['concept_system_map'], or £interface£ ['concept_galaxy_map'], and send it against an opponent.

entries.zh: §L“他们的指挥官似乎有更棒的战术。而我们只不过是船更大罢了。”§!
entries.en: §L'Their admiral had a winning strategy. We had bigger ships.'§!

entries.zh: 在£interface£['concept_technology_view']，研究一项武器科技，例如£physics£['concept_physics_research']中的§H激光§!或£engineering£['concept_engineering_research']中的§H导弹§!。
entries.en: In the £interface£ ['concept_technology_view'], research a weapon technology, such as §HLasers§! in the £physics£ ['concept_physics_research'] or §HMissiles§! in £engineering£ ['concept_engineering_research'].

entries.zh: §L“用兵之法，科技为上，伐兵次之。”——第二攻击群，伊格维-伊诺尔§!
entries.en: §L'War isn't won on the battlefield. It's won in the lab.' - Igvi-Inor, 2nd Attack Swarm§!

entries.zh: 部署一支由£commander£['concept_commander']指挥的['concept_fleet']，进入战场战斗。也可以指派其作为['concept_governor']或作为['concept_council']。\n\n每项任务都可以提供宝贵的经验值，使其等级提升并发展出新['concept_leader_traits']。
entries.en: Deploy a ['concept_fleet'], led by a £commander£ ['concept_commander'], to engage in battle. Alternatively, assign them as a ['concept_governor'] or to the ['concept_council'].\n\nSuch duties provide valuable experience, allowing them to level up and develop new ['concept_leader_traits'].

entries.zh: §L“菜鸟学习战斗的技巧。老道的指挥官学习战斗的时机。”——《新太空战争学说》§!
entries.en: §L'Rookies learn how to fight. Experienced Commanders learn when to fight.' - New Doctrines in Space Warfare§!

entries.zh: 在$concept_fleet_management_view$的$fleet_management_view_tab_fleet_manager$选项卡，设计并以共计20艘§H驱逐舰§!增援一支或多支['concept_fleets']，或使用['concept_shipyard']逐一建造。
entries.en: In the $fleet_management_view_tab_fleet_manager$ tab of the $concept_fleet_management_view$, design and reinforce one or more ['concept_fleets'] with 20 combined §HDestroyers§!, or use a ['concept_shipyard'] to build the ships individually.

entries.zh: §L“坚固持久，廉价易得。这就是指挥官们所说的‘最佳投资’。”§!
entries.en: §L'Armored enough to last, cheap enough to lose. That's what command calls "a good investment."'§!

entries.zh: 在$concept_fleet_management_view$的$fleet_management_view_tab_fleet_manager$选项卡，设计并以共计10只§H太空变形虫母§!增援一支或多支['concept_fleets']。也可以用['concept_beastport']来逐一建造，或让现有的§H太空变形虫§!生长。
entries.en: In the $fleet_management_view_tab_fleet_manager$ tab of the $concept_fleet_management_view$, design and reinforce one or more ['concept_fleets'] with 10 §HSpace Amoeba Mothers§!. Alternatively, use a ['concept_beastport'] to clone them individually or let existing §HSpace Amoebas§! grow.

entries.zh: §L“对我们，她是一件兵器。对她的孩子们，她就是家。”§!
entries.en: §L'To us, she is a weapon. To her children, she is home.'§!

entries.zh: 在£interface£['concept_fleet_management_view']的$fleet_management_view_tab_fleet_manager$选项卡或['concept_shipyard']中，建造二十艘§H织蛛§!生物舰船。
entries.en: In either the $fleet_management_view_tab_fleet_manager$ tab of the £interface£ ['concept_fleet_management_view'] or a ['concept_shipyard'], produce twenty biological §HWeaver§! ships.

entries.zh: §L“织蛛可不只是战舰，它们是战力倍增器，是决定你的舰队是一盘散沙还是有机整体的关键。”——《突触战争学说》第四卷§!
entries.en: §L'A Weaver is more than a combat vessel; it is a force multiplier, the difference between a scattered fleet and a single, lethal organism.' - Synaptic War Doctrine, Vol. IV§!
In the $contacts_view_tab_contacts$ tab of the £interface£ ['concept_contacts_view'], declare a ['concept_war'] with another ['concept_empire'].

entries.zh: §L“追求荣誉，保卫帝国，为了命运！前进！”——第54进攻部队战吼§!
entries.en: §L'For honor, for empire, for destiny! Onward!' - Battle cry of the 54th Assault Army§!

entries.zh: 在£interface£['concept_colony_view']的$colony_view_tab_planet_summary$选项卡或£interface£['concept_planets_and_sector_view']中，指派一位£commander£['concept_commander']作为一个£sector£['concept_sector']或£planet£['concept_planet']的['concept_governor']。
entries.en: In either the $colony_view_tab_planet_summary$ tab of the £interface£ ['concept_colony_view'] or in the £interface£ ['concept_planets_and_sector_view'], assign a £commander£ ['concept_commander'] as a ['concept_governor'] of a £sector£ ['concept_sector'] or £planet£ ['concept_planet'].

entries.zh: §L“列车准点发车，例行巡逻也是如此。”§!
entries.en: §L'The trains run on time. But so do the patrols.'§!

entries.zh: 有一位指挥官作为总督
§L“战争的淬炼不能让人变得聪明，但能让人变得高效。”——寇道夫司令§!
entries.en: §L'Experience in war does not make one wise. It makes one efficient.' - Admiral Kol'dolf§!

entries.zh: 拥有一位4级或以上的指挥官
entries.en: Has a Commander at Level 4 or higher

entries.zh: 在£interface£['concept_contacts_view']的$contacts_view_tab_contacts$选项卡，向另一个['concept_empire']发起['concept_war']。建造并指挥一支强大的£fleet_size£['concept_fleet']，与敌军交战，占领关键£planet£['concept_colonies']直到获得胜利。
entries.en: In the $contacts_view_tab_contacts$ tab of the £interface£ ['concept_contacts_view'], declare a ['concept_war'] with another ['concept_empire']. Build and command a strong £fleet_size£ ['concept_fleet'], engage enemy forces, and occupy key £planet£ ['concept_colonies'] until victory is secured.

entries.zh: §L“胜利不是结束，而是负担的转移。愚妄者以征服为乐，智者早就开始了从长计议。”——《刀锋之缘》华瓦上师§!
entries.en: §L'Victory is not the end, but the shifting of burdens. The foolish revel in conquest; the wise turn to what follows.' - Master Huava, The Edge of the Blade'§!

entries.zh: 在建立通讯后，利用$concept_contacts_view$的$contacts_view_tab_contacts$选项卡向§H佣兵城邦§!雇佣一支['concept_fleet']。
entries.en: After establishing contact, use the $contacts_view_tab_contacts$ tab of the $concept_contacts_view$ to hire a ['concept_fleet'] from the §HMercenary Enclave§!.

entries.zh: §L“金钱买不来忠诚，但可以租到获胜为止。”§!
entries.en: §L'You can't buy loyalty, but you can rent it long enough to win.'§!

entries.zh: 在$concept_starbase_view$的$starbase_view_tab_armies$选项卡或$concept_colony_view$的$colony_view_tab_armies$选项卡，雇佣10支['concept_armies']。
entries.en: In either the $starbase_view_tab_armies$ tab of the $concept_starbase_view$ or the $colony_view_tab_armies$ tab of the $concept_colony_view$, recruit 10 ['concept_armies'].

entries.zh: §L“敌军清点兵力，我们清点生物质。”§!
entries.en: §L'The enemy counts soldiers. We count biomass.'§!

entries.zh: 将一支['concept_fleet']部署在敌对£colony£['concept_colony']的上空便会开始§H轨道轰炸§!。不使用['concept_armies']加以入侵而是让§H$concept_fleet$§!轰炸§H$concept_colony$§!直到其投降为止。
entries.en: Place a ['concept_fleet'] in orbit of a hostile £colony£ ['concept_colony'], which starts §HOrbital Bombardment§!. Instead of using ['concept_armies'] to invade the planet, let the §H$concept_fleet$§! bombard the §H$concept_colony$§! until it surrenders.

entries.zh: §L“攻城不是力量的比拼，而是韧性的较量。行星撑住了，舰队就会陷入一片火海；舰队撑住了，行星就不得不卑躬屈膝。”——《持久战》莱恩托克·沙尔·帕拉特§!
entries.en: §L'A siege is not a contest of strength, but of endurance. The planet holds, and the fleet burns. The fleet holds, the planet kneels.' - Rhentok shar Platt, A Protracted War§!
Has forced a Planet to Surrender

entries.zh: 在£interface£['concept_claims_view']，向另一['concept_empire']的起始§H§!£colony£['concept_colonies']放置['concept_claims']。在£interface£['concept_contacts_view']的$contacts_view_tab_contacts$选项卡宣布§H宣称§!['concept_war']。让['concept_armies']登陆入侵该§H母星§!并结束战争。
entries.en: In the £interface£ ['concept_claims_view'], put ['concept_claims'] on the starting §HHomeworld§! £colony£ ['concept_colonies'] of another ['concept_empire']. In the $contacts_view_tab_contacts$ tab of the £interface£ ['concept_contacts_view'], declare a ['concept_war'] of §HClaim§!. Land ['concept_armies'] on the §HHomeworld§! to invade them and finish the war.

entries.zh: §L“这颗他们所谓的帝国之心，现在为我们跳动。”§!
entries.en: §L'They called it the heart of their empire. Now it beats for us.'§!

entries.zh: 在£interface£['concept_contacts_view']的$contacts_view_tab_contacts$选项卡，对另一个£nomad£ ['concept_nomadic_empire']发起一场§H$war_goal_wg_nomad_raid$§!['concept_war']。征服任意一艘瘫痪的£arkship£ ['concept_arkships']。
entries.en: In the $contacts_view_tab_contacts$ tab of the £interface£ ['concept_contacts_view'], declare a ['concept_war'] of §H$war_goal_wg_nomad_raid$§! on another £nomad£ ['concept_nomadic_empire']. Any disabled £arkship£ ['concept_arkships'] are conquered.

entries.zh: §L“航行日志在句子中途戛然而止。我们的则从同一行开始。”§!
entries.en: §L'The navigation logs ended mid-sentence. Ours began on the same line.'§!

entries.zh: 在£interface£ ['concept_galaxy_map']上接受一份§H$contract_raid_planet_small$§!合约，然后派遣['concept_fleets']对目标帝国的['concept_colonies']执行§H$ORBITAL_BOMBARDMENT$§!。
entries.en: Accept a §H$contract_raid_planet_small$§! contract on the £interface£ ['concept_galaxy_map'], then send ['concept_fleets'] to perform §H$ORBITAL_BOMBARDMENT$§! on the target empire's ['concept_colonies'].

entries.zh: §L“我们不过问客户为何想要让一颗星球屈服。”§!
entries.en: §L'We do not ask why the client wants a world humbled.'§!

entries.zh: §L“身经百战的指挥官不是从训练和纸上谈兵里来的。他们要从无情的虚空中淬炼而出。”§!
entries.en: §L'A veteran Commander is not made by training, nor by theory. They are shaped by the void.'§!

entries.zh: §L“他们埋葬我们的星球，粉碎我们的舰队，让我们自生自灭。我们绝不会忘记。”§!
entries.en: §L'They burned our worlds, shattered our fleets, and left us for dead. Well, we're still here. And we do not forget.'§!

entries.zh: 在全面战争中幸存下来

entries.en: Engage in a ['concept_fleet'] battle with the §HKhan§!.

entries.zh: §L“我们的第一个失误是小瞧他，第二个失误是误以为我们有机会犯第三个错。”§!
entries.en: §L'Our first mistake was underestimating him. The second was assuming we'd get the chance to make a third.'§!
Engage in a ['concept_fleet'] battle with the §HGray Tempest§!.

entries.zh: 与['concept_fallen_empire']战斗，直至他们最后一颗£planet£['concept_planet']被征服。
entries.en: Fight a ['concept_fallen_empire'] until their last £planet£ ['concept_planet'] is conquered.

entries.zh: §L“叫我们暴发户，他们也不看看自己在餐桌旁还是餐桌上。”§!
entries.en: §L'They called us upstarts. We called them dinner.'§!

entries.zh: 要建造新的§H$military_arkship_name$§!，请选择一艘现有的£arkship£ ['concept_arkship']，然后点击§H建造巨型结构§!。随后，选择要建造的方舟舰级别。
entries.en: To build a new §H$military_arkship_name$§!, select an existing £arkship£ ['concept_arkship'] and click §HBuild Megastructure§!. From there, select the Arkship Class to build.

entries.zh: §L“让他们去测绘群星，让他们去编录虚空。而我们要做的，就是让他们在埋头于此之时，也不得不时刻提防身后。”——战略家尤拉·维恩，《论权力的目的》§!
entries.en: §L'Let them map the stars. Let them catalogue the void. We will be the reason they look over their shoulder while they do it.' - Strategos Yura Venn, On the Purpose of Power§!

entries.zh: 在研究£society£§H$tech_mega_shipyard$§!科技后，找到一颗合适的['concept_star']并派遣一艘£construction_ship£['concept_construction_ship']建造§H$tech_mega_shipyard$§!['concept_megastructure']。
entries.en: After researching the £society£ §H$tech_mega_shipyard$§! technology, find a suitable ['concept_star'] and use a £construction_ship£ ['concept_construction_ship'] to build the §H$tech_mega_shipyard$§! ['concept_megastructure'].

entries.zh: §L“能在建设上超越对手的帝国，无需在战场上战胜对手——《战争经济学》内因•阿伏伽迪将军”§!
entries.en: §L'The empire that outbuilds its rivals does not need to outfight them.' - Strategos Neyn Arvogadi, On the Economics of War§!

entries.zh: 在£interface£['concept_contacts_view']的$contacts_view_tab_contacts$选项卡，对其他['concept_empires']宣布['concept_subjugation_war']并将其击败。$focus_other$
entries.en: In the $contacts_view_tab_contacts$ tab of the £interface£ ['concept_contacts_view'], declare a ['concept_subjugation_war'] with other ['concept_empires'] and defeat them.$focus_other$

entries.zh: §L“附庸不是盟友，而是一种资源，需要加以栽培、控制，若有需要，还得矫正。”——威尔·乌格拉姆总理§!
entries.en: §L'A subject is not an ally, but a resource. One that must be cultivated, controlled, and, when necessary, corrected.' - Chancellor Vel Wuhglaam§!

entries.zh: 在£interface£['concept_claims_view']，向另一个['concept_empire']的£colony£['concept_colonies']放置['concept_claims']。在£interface£['concept_contacts_view']的$contacts_view_tab_contacts$选项卡，宣布§H宣称§!['concept_war']。让['concept_armies']登陆入侵该星球并结束战争。
entries.en: In the £interface£ ['concept_claims_view'], put ['concept_claims'] on the £colony£ ['concept_colonies'] of another ['concept_empire']. In the $contacts_view_tab_contacts$ tab of the £interface£ ['concept_contacts_view'], declare a ['concept_war'] of §HClaim§!. Land ['concept_armies'] on the worlds to invade them and finish the war.

entries.zh: §L“征服不是毁灭性的，而是一种重定向。最明智的国家无需增长——只需吸纳即可。”§!
entries.en: §L'Conquest is not destruction; it is redirection. The wisest nations do not grow - they absorb.'§!

entries.zh: 在£interface£['concept_situation_log_view']的$situation_log_view_tab_situation_log$选项卡中，找到复活星神兽的['concept_special_project']并进行研究。
entries.en: In the $situation_log_view_tab_situation_log$ tab of the £interface£ ['concept_situation_log_view'], find the ['concept_special_project'] for the reanimation of a Leviathan and research it.

entries.zh: §L“活着的星神兽才能发挥它的作用。”§!
entries.en: §L'Only a revived Leviathan is a useful Leviathan.'§!

entries.zh: 已经复活了一只星神兽
在['concept_fleet']界面中，完成相关要求以组建佣兵。
entries.en: In the ['concept_fleet'] view, fulfill the requirements in order to form Mercenaries.

entries.zh: §L“佣兵如彗星一般，闪耀而暴烈，只有在远处欣赏方能无恙。”§!
entries.en: §L'Mercenaries are like comets: bright, violent, and best admired from afar.'§!

entries.zh: 在£interface£['concept_fleet_management_view']的$fleet_management_view_tab_fleet_manager$选项卡或['concept_shipyard']中，建造十艘§H战列舰§!。
entries.en: In either the $fleet_management_view_tab_fleet_manager$ tab of the £interface£ ['concept_fleet_management_view'] or a ['concept_shipyard'], build ten §HBattleships§!.

entries.zh: §L“在星球轨道中建造，并藉由最新科技臻于完善。战列舰是一切舰队中的冠上明珠。”§!
entries.en: §L'Forged in orbit and perfected by the latest science. Battleships are the crown jewel of any armada.'§!

entries.zh: 在£interface£['concept_fleet_management_view']的$fleet_management_view_tab_fleet_manager$选项卡或['concept_shipyard']中，建造两艘§H泰坦§!。
entries.en: In either the $fleet_management_view_tab_fleet_manager$ tab of the £interface£ ['concept_fleet_management_view'] or a ['concept_shipyard'], build two §HTitans§!.

entries.zh: §L“帝国疆域因泰坦之荣光而尽数改写。”§!
entries.en: §L'Maps will be redrawn to where the glorious Titan point.'§!

entries.zh: 在£interface£['concept_fleet_management_view']的$fleet_management_view_tab_fleet_manager$选项卡或['concept_shipyard']中，建造一艘§H主宰§!。
entries.en: In either the $fleet_management_view_tab_fleet_manager$ tab of the £interface£ ['concept_fleet_management_view'] or a ['concept_shipyard'], build one §HJuggernaut§!.

entries.zh: §L“是船坞，也是一座堡垒，亦是最后通牒，这就是主宰。”§!
entries.en: §L'A forge, a fortress, and a final statement: the Juggernaut.'§!

entries.zh: 要在£arkship£ ['concept_arkship']上装备§H轴基挂载§!，请前往完全升级的§H方舟舰§!上的£interface£ ['concept_colony_view']的§H$ARKSHIP_CONTROLS$§!选项卡。点击§H轴基挂载槽位§!，然后从列表中选择§H毁灭者挂载§!。
entries.en: To equip a §HSpinal Mount§! on an £arkship£ ['concept_arkship'], go to the §H$ARKSHIP_CONTROLS$§! tab of the £interface£ ['concept_colony_view'] on a fully upgraded §HArkship§!. Click on the §HSpinal Mount Slot§! and select the §HDevastator Mount§! from the list.

entries.zh: §L“命令下达时，每一层甲板的灯光都会暗下。黑暗中，数百万人屏住呼吸；随后，虚空反而亮起。船员们称之为‘长瞬’。”§!
entries.en: §L'The lights dim across every deck when the order is given. Millions hold their breath in the dark, and then the void lights up instead. The crew calls it the Long Blink.'§!

entries.zh: 派遣一艘£science_ship£['concept_science_ship']调查新£system£['concept_systems']直至发起§H第一次接触§!流程。指派一位['concept_envoy']来领导这项工作直到得到结果。
entries.en: Send a £science_ship£ ['concept_science_ship'] to survey new £system£ ['concept_systems'] until the §HFirst Contact§! procedure is initiated. Assign an ['concept_envoy'] to lead the effort until its conclusion.

entries.zh: §L“两个文明相遇的那一刻，历史的轨迹便开始变动。这条路会通向和平或是战争，或许就在一个词语之间。”——特使达特利·尤康纳§!
entries.en: §L'The moment two civilizations meet, the course of history changes. Whether that change leads to peace or war may depend on a single word.' - Envoy Datri Yukonna§!

entries.zh: 激励£pop£['concept_pop']增长需要确保£colony£['concept_colonies']有足够的£housing£['concept_housing']。$focus_other$
entries.en: To encourage £pop£ ['concept_pop'] growth, ensure that there is sufficient £housing£ ['concept_housing'] on £colony£ ['concept_colonies'].$focus_other$

entries.zh: §L“一个帝国的强大程度取决于它是否有能力养活那些以之为家的人。”——策展人阿尔坎·德奥特§!
entries.en: §L'An empire is only as strong as its ability to sustain those who call it home.' - Curator Arkan Teot§!

entries.zh: 激励£pop£['concept_pop']增长需要确保£colony£['concept_colonies']有足够的£housing£['concept_housing']。$focus_other$
entries.en: To encourage £pop£ ['concept_pop'] growth, ensure that there is sufficient £housing£ ['concept_housing'] on £colony£ ['concept_colonies'].$focus_other$

entries.zh: §L“让关系破冰不是为了交流感情，我们为了需求而来。” ——CHO第1142号指令§!
entries.en: §L'We do not thaw for sentiment; we thaw for demand.' - CHO Directive 1142§!

entries.zh: 在£interface£['concept_government_view']的§H$government_view_tab_factions$§!选项卡，点击§H$POP_FACTION_MANAGE$§!并鼓励一个['concept_faction']。
entries.en: In the §H$government_view_tab_factions$§! tab of the £interface£ ['concept_government_view'], click §H$POP_FACTION_MANAGE$§! and promote a ['concept_faction'].

entries.zh: §L“领导的艺术可不是让所有人满意。只是慢慢地让人失望，使其不至于产生暴乱。”§!
entries.en: §LThe trick to leadership isn't pleasing everyone. It's disappointing them slowly enough that they don't revolt.§!

entries.zh: 提升£minerals£['concept_minerals']的产出需要在£interface£['concept_colony_view']建造£district£['concept_mining_districts']、在蕴含矿物的['concept_celestial_objects']周围建造£mining_station£['concept_mining_stations']，或在£market£['concept_market']添加月度交易。
entries.en: To increase the income of £minerals£ ['concept_minerals'], build £district£ ['concept_mining_districts'] in the £interface£ ['concept_colony_view'], £mining_station£ ['concept_mining_stations'] around mineral-rich ['concept_celestial_objects'], or add a monthly trade in the £market£ ['concept_market'].

entries.zh: 将矿物月度收入提升至50
在£interface£['concept_contacts_view']的$contacts_view_tab_contacts$选项卡，选择§H提升关系§!并指派一位可用的['concept_envoy']。
entries.en: In the $contacts_view_tab_contacts$ tab of the £interface£ ['concept_contacts_view'], select §HImprove Relations§! and assign an available ['concept_envoy'].

entries.zh: §L“外交的基础不是信任，而是利益。只要利益一致，敌人也能合作。而如果利益不一致，朋友也能变成绊脚石。”§!
entries.en: §L'Diplomacy is not built on trust. It is built on interests. Align them, and enemies become partners. Fail, and partners become obstacles.'§!

entries.zh: 与另一帝国拥有良好关系。
entries.en: Has a Positive Relationship with another empire
In the £interface£ ['concept_leaders_view'], hire a recruitable ['concept_leader'] of the £official£ ['concept_official'] class.$focus_other$
§L'Empires rise and fall. But paperwork is forever.'§!

entries.zh: 在£arkship£ ['concept_arkship']的£interface£ §H舰队视图§!中，点击§H$arkship_harvest_resources$§!舰队命令，然后选择一个合适的['concept_planet']。
entries.en: In the £interface£ §HFleet View§! of an £arkship£ ['concept_arkship'], click the §H$arkship_harvest_resources$§! fleet order and select a suitable ['concept_planet'].

entries.zh: §L“我们无需拥有一颗星球，也能对其加以利用。”§!
entries.en: §L'We do not need to own a world to make use of it.'§!

entries.zh: 在£interface£['concept_contacts_view']的$contacts_view_tab_contacts$选项卡，向另一个['concept_empire']提出该['concept_diplomatic_pact']。
entries.en: In the $contacts_view_tab_contacts$ tab of the £interface£ ['concept_contacts_view'], propose this ['concept_diplomatic_pact'] with another ['concept_empire'].

entries.zh: §L“互不侵犯不意味着和平。它只是暂时这么一说，毕竟战争比合作麻烦一些。”§!
entries.en: §L'A non-aggression pact is not peace. It is merely a promise that, for now, cooperation is more convenient than war.'§!

entries.zh: 在£interface£['concept_contacts_view']的$contacts_view_tab_contacts$选项卡，向另一个['concept_empire']提出该['concept_diplomatic_pact']。
entries.en: In the $contacts_view_tab_contacts$ tab of the £interface£ ['concept_contacts_view'], propose this ['concept_diplomatic_pact'] with another ['concept_empire'].

entries.zh: §L“没有什么比共同威胁更能让两个帝国走到一起。”§!
entries.en: §L'Nothing brings two empires together like the mutual fear of a third.'§!

entries.zh: 在£interface£['concept_colony_view']的$colony_view_tab_planet_summary$选项卡或£interface£['concept_planets_and_sector_view']中，指派一位£official£['concept_official']作为一个£sector£['concept_sector']或£planet£['concept_planet']的['concept_governor']。
entries.en: In either the $colony_view_tab_planet_summary$ tab of the £interface£ ['concept_colony_view'] or in the £interface£ ['concept_planets_and_sector_view'], assign an £official£ ['concept_official'] as a ['concept_governor'] of a £sector£ ['concept_sector'] or £planet£ ['concept_planet'].

entries.zh: §L“统治者受人称赞。将军令人畏惧。而真正的管理者两者皆非，他们的工作需要在不被注意的时候做得最好。”——行政官福伦特·沙尔·阿斯塔腾§!
entries.en: §L'A ruler is praised. A general is feared. A true administrator is neither, for their work is done best when it goes unnoticed.' - Prefect Flent shar Astatenn§!

entries.zh: 响应加入['concept_galactic_community']的邀请，或在其成立之后，在£interface£['concept_outliner']上方打开§H$concept_galactic_community$§!申请加入。
entries.en: Answer the invitation to join the ['concept_galactic_community'], or open the §H$concept_galactic_community$§! above the £interface£ ['concept_outliner'] after it has formed and request to join.

entries.zh: §L“我们曾是孤单的种子。现在，我们是繁星之间欣欣向荣的花园的一分子”——星海共同体首席发言人墨黑之花瓣§!
entries.en: §L'We were once a single seed. Now, we are part of a garden that blooms across the stars.' - Petals of Black, First Speaker of the Galactic Community§!

entries.zh: 在£interface£['concept_contacts_view']的$contacts_view_tab_contacts$选项卡，联络另一个['concept_empire']并选择§H提升关系§!直至他们给出['concept_favor']。$focus_other$
entries.en: In the $contacts_view_tab_contacts$ tab of the £interface£ ['concept_contacts_view'], contact another ['concept_empire'] and select §HImprove Relations§! until they grant a ['concept_favor'].$focus_other$

entries.zh: §L“外交支持不是通货，但用起来差不多。它没有重量，却可以压动外交的天平。”§!
entries.en: §L'A favor is not currency, yet it spends like one. It holds no weight, yet it can tip the scales of diplomacy.'§!

entries.zh: 指派£official£['concept_official']到['concept_council']、作为['concept_governor']、到['concept_galactic_community']或['concept_federation']。\n\n每项任务都可以提供宝贵的经验值，使其等级提升并发展出新['concept_leader_traits']。
entries.en: Assign the £official£ ['concept_official'] to the ['concept_council'], as ['concept_governor'], to the ['concept_galactic_community'], or a ['concept_federation'].\n\nSuch duties provide valuable experience, allowing them to level up and develop new ['concept_leader_traits'].

entries.zh: §L“总督第一课：如果所有人都不开心，你可能就做对了。”《无聊的考验：行政官指导手册》§!
entries.en: §L'The first lesson of governance: if no one is happy, you're probably doing it right.' - Trial by Tedium, the Official Guidebook§!

entries.zh: 在£interface£ ['concept_galaxy_map']上接受一份§H$arkship_harvest_resources$§!合约，然后派遣['concept_logistic_ships']执行§H$arkship_harvest_resources$§!舰队指令。
entries.en: Accept a §H$arkship_harvest_resources$§! contract on the £interface£ ['concept_galaxy_map'], then send ['concept_logistic_ships'] to perform the §H$arkship_harvest_resources$§! fleet order.

entries.zh: §L“开采期间，提取舱热得发烫；每一道舱壁上都凝满水汽，船员轮班作业，只为让处理机永不停歇。我们不留下岩石，只留下名声。”§!
entries.en: §L'The extraction bay runs hot during a harvest; condensation on every bulkhead, crews working in shifts so the processors never cool down. We don't keep the rock, just the reputation.'§!

entries.zh: 在研究£physics£§H$tech_dyson_swarm$§!科技后，找到一颗合适的['concept_star']并派遣一艘£construction_ship£['concept_construction_ship']建造§H$tech_dyson_swarm$§!£megastructure£['concept_megastructure']。
entries.en: After researching the £physics£ §H$tech_dyson_swarm$§! technology, find a suitable ['concept_star'] and use a £construction_ship£ ['concept_construction_ship'] to build the §H$tech_dyson_swarm$§! £megastructure£ ['concept_megastructure'].

entries.zh: §L“盯着这颗恒星我们陷入深思：‘是不是也能收它的税啊？’”§!
entries.en: §L'We took one look at that star and thought: "What if we taxed it?"'§!

entries.zh: 在研究£engineering£§H$tech_orbital_arc_furnace$§!科技后，在至少拥有15颗£planet£['concept_planets']的£system£['concept_system']找到一颗合适的§H熔融星球§!并派遣一艘£construction_ship£['concept_construction_ship']建造§H$tech_orbital_arc_furnace$§!£megastructure£['concept_megastructure']。
entries.en: After researching the £engineering£ §H$tech_orbital_arc_furnace$§! technology, find a §HMolten World§! in a £system£ ['concept_system'] with at least 15 £planet£ ['concept_planets'] and use a £construction_ship£ ['concept_construction_ship'] to build the §H$tech_orbital_arc_furnace$§! £megastructure£ ['concept_megastructure'].

entries.zh: §L“恒星在地平线上升起，刹那间整座结构都燃烧着金色的光。数千公里长的脚手架和钢材……由我们建成。我们让这颗星球成为了自己的熔炉。”§!
entries.en: §L'The sun crests the horizon, and for a moment, the whole structure burns gold. Thousands of kilometers of scaffolding and steel... We built this. We made this planet our forge.'§!

entries.zh: 在£interface£['concept_contacts_view']的$contacts_view_tab_contacts$选项卡，向另一个['concept_empire']提出一项§H$PACT_migration_treaty$§!['concept_diplomatic_pact']。$focus_other$
entries.en: In the $contacts_view_tab_contacts$ tab of the £interface£ ['concept_contacts_view'], propose a §H$PACT_migration_treaty$§! ['concept_diplomatic_pact'] with another ['concept_empire'].$focus_other$

entries.zh: §L\"星系浩瀚无垠，充满了各种知识、技能和理念。为什么要局限在一种思维方式中呢？\"§!
entries.en: §L'The galaxy is vast, full of knowledge, skills, and ideas. Why settle for just one way of thinking?'§!

entries.zh: 在£interface£['concept_contacts_view']的$contacts_view_tab_contacts$选项卡，联络另一个['concept_empire']并请求他们组建['concept_federation']。$focus_other$
entries.en: In the $contacts_view_tab_contacts$ tab of the £interface£ ['concept_contacts_view'], contact another ['concept_empire'] and ask them to form a ['concept_federation'].$focus_other$

entries.zh: §L“让这项协议成为我们决心的证明：我们选择团结而非分裂，选择对话而非战争，坚信星系的共同命运。”——《星海共同体序言》§!
entries.en: §L'Let this accord stand as a testament to our resolve: that we choose unity over division, dialogue over war, and a shared destiny among the stars.' - Preamble to the Galactic Concord§!

entries.zh: 充分提升['concept_diplomatic_weight']在下一次['concept_galactic_council']选举中当选。
entries.en: Increase ['concept_diplomatic_weight'] sufficiently before the next ['concept_galactic_council'] election to be voted in.

entries.zh: §L“真正的权力不在舰队或陆军，而是在做出决策的密室里。”§!
entries.en: §L'True power is not found in fleets or armies, but in the chambers where decisions are made.'§!

entries.zh: §L“当一天过去时，感到疲惫的应该是劳动者，而不是他们的领袖。”——首席法官伊尔布·瓦比尔§!
entries.en: §L'At the end of the day it's the workers who should be tired, not their leaders.' - Chief Magistrate Ir'B va'Bir§!

entries.zh: §L“‘独立经济蓬勃发展，巨型企业第十家分部成立’，当地官员宣称。”§!
entries.en: §L'"Independent Economy Thriving as Mega Corporation Opens 10th Branch Office," claims local official.'§!

entries.zh: 在£arkship£ ['concept_arkship']的£interface£ §H舰队视图§!中，点击§H$arkship_strip_mine$§!舰队命令，然后选择一个合适的['concept_planet']。
entries.en: In the £interface£ §HFleet View§! of an £arkship£ ['concept_arkship'], click the §H$arkship_strip_mine$§! fleet order and select a suitable ['concept_planet'].

entries.zh: §L“客气的说法是开采。诚实的说法是掏空。不管怎样，货舱都满了。”§!
entries.en: §L'The polite word is extraction. The honest word is gutting. Either way, the holds are full.'§!

entries.zh: 已对一颗行星进行露天开采
指派一位£official£['concept_official']到['concept_federation']以提升§H联邦经验§!。
entries.en: Assign an £official£ ['concept_official'] to the ['concept_federation'] to increase the §HFederation Experience§!.

entries.zh: §L“有了五个政府层级，数百个委员会，开了几千场会议后——我们不知怎么地就变强了。”§!
entries.en: §L'Five levels of government, a hundred committees, a thousand meetings - and somehow, we're stronger for it.'§!
After researching the £physics£ §H$tech_dyson_sphere$§! technology, upgrade the §H$tech_dyson_swarm$§! £megastructure£ ['concept_megastructure'] to a §H$tech_dyson_sphere$§!.$focus_other$

entries.zh: 在研究£physics£§H$tech_dyson_sphere$§!科技后，找到一颗合适的['concept_star']并派遣一艘£construction_ship£['concept_construction_ship']建造§H$tech_dyson_sphere$§!£megastructure£['concept_megastructure']。$focus_other$
entries.en: After researching the £physics£ §H$tech_dyson_sphere$§! technology, find a suitable ['concept_star'] and use a £construction_ship£ ['concept_construction_ship'] to build the §H$tech_dyson_sphere$§! £megastructure£ ['concept_megastructure'].$focus_other$

entries.zh: §L“最高等级的文明不会为资源竞争，他们规定什么叫资源”——《第三位次的进阶》§!
entries.en: §L'The highest civilization does not compete for resources - it defines them.' - Advancement of the Third Rank§!

entries.zh: 在研究£physics£§H$tech_ring_world$§!科技后，找到的一颗合适的['concept_star']并派遣一艘£construction_ship£['concept_construction_ship']建造§H$tech_ring_world$§!£megastructure£['concept_megastructure']。$focus_other$
entries.en: After researching the £physics£ §H$tech_ring_world$§! technology, find a suitable ['concept_star'] and use a £construction_ship£ ['concept_construction_ship'] to build the §H$tech_ring_world$§! £megastructure£ ['concept_megastructure'].$focus_other$

entries.zh: §L“在我们恒星的照耀下，环世界是如此魅力。而侵略者的影子却不期而至……”——《阿德阿夫·尤维-瓦迪夫日记》174标准§!
entries.en: §L'The Ring was so beautiful in the light of our star. Then the shadows of the invaders fell upon it...' - Diary of Addavv uvi-Waddiv, Standard 174§!

entries.zh: §L“数十年的督管经验让他们熟练掌握了政策制定、讨价还价和推卸责任的技巧。”§!
entries.en: §L'Decades of governance have made them masters of policy, negotiation, and passing the blame.'§!

entries.zh: 在邻近恒星系中建造£waystation£ ['concept_waystations']以创建一条£wayline£ ['concept_wayline']。
entries.en: Build £waystation£ ['concept_waystations'] in neighboring systems to create a £wayline£ ['concept_wayline'].

entries.zh: §L“一个单独的驿站只是一声低语。将它们连缀起来，整个星系都会听见你说话。”§!
entries.en: §L'A single waystation is a whisper. String them together and the galaxy hears you speak.'§!

entries.zh: 具有一段长度为5的驿道
要建造新的£arkship£ ['concept_arkship']，请选择一个现有的§H$concept_arkship$§!，然后点击§H建造巨型结构§!。随后，选择要建造的方舟舰级别。
entries.en: To build a new £arkship£ ['concept_arkship'], select an existing §H$concept_arkship$§! and click §HBuild Megastructure§!. From there, select the Arkship Class to build.

entries.zh: §L“一张弓指向星系的边缘，一张指向它炽烈的核心，还有一张指向星图尚未命名之物。”§!
entries.en: §L'One bow pointed to the edge of the galaxy, one toward its blazing heart, and one toward something the star charts have not yet named.'§!

entries.zh: 要建造新的§H$civilian_arkship_name$§!，请选择一艘现有的£arkship£ ['concept_arkship']，然后点击§H建造巨型结构§!。之后，选择要建造的方舟舰级别。
entries.en: To build a new §H$civilian_arkship_name$§!, select an existing £arkship£ ['concept_arkship'] and click §HBuild Megastructure§!. From there, select the Arkship Class to build.

entries.zh: §L“城市梦想着向外扩张，而方舟舰梦想着前方的未知。” ——档案管理员托尔·恩纳拉，《论家的本质》§!
entries.en: §L'A city dreams of growing outward. An Arkship dreams of what lies ahead.' - Archivist Tol Ennara, On the Nature of Home§!

entries.zh: 在研究£society£§H$tech_interstellar_assembly$§!科技之后，找到一颗合适的['concept_star']并派遣一艘£construction_ship£['concept_construction_ship']建造§H$tech_interstellar_assembly$§!£megastructure£['concept_megastructure']。$focus_other$
entries.en: After researching the £society£ §H$tech_interstellar_assembly$§! technology, find a suitable ['concept_star'] and use a £construction_ship£ ['concept_construction_ship'] to build the §H$tech_interstellar_assembly$§! £megastructure£ ['concept_megastructure'].$focus_other$

entries.zh: §L“控制得了沟通交流就能控制历史的进程。”——至高总理萨古·苏布之女§!
entries.en: §L'To control the conversation is to control the course of history.' - High Chancellor Sagu, daughter of Thub§!

entries.zh: 收集£consumer_goods£['concept_consumer_goods']需要在£interface£['concept_colony_view']的$colony_view_tab_planet_summary$选项卡建造£district£['concept_industrial_districts']和£building£['building:building_factory_1']、在£market£['concept_market']或向其他['concept_empires']购买£consumer_goods£§H$concept_consumer_goods$§!。
entries.en: To gather £consumer_goods£ ['concept_consumer_goods'], build £district£ ['concept_industrial_districts'] and £building£ ['building:building_factory_1'] in the $colony_view_tab_planet_summary$ tab of the £interface£ ['concept_colony_view'], buy £consumer_goods£ §H$concept_consumer_goods$§! on the £market£ ['concept_market'], or from other ['concept_empires'].

entries.zh: §L“他们既不吃这个，也不用来扩张。有些甚至就只是……用来摆着看。个体的低效简直令人抓狂。”§!
entries.en: §L'They do not eat them. They do not use them to expand. Some are simply... displayed. The inefficiency of the individuals is maddening.'§!

entries.zh: §L“如此受人欢迎也是件让人精疲力尽的事”§!
要部署§H噬天巨兽卵§!，选择['concept_construction_ship']点击§H建造巨型结构§!。从中选择噬天巨兽卵，并找到一颗合适的§H气态巨行星§!将其建造在轨道上。
entries.en: Deploy a §HBehemoth Egg§! by selecting your ['concept_construction_ship'] and clicking §HBuild Megastructure§!. From there, select Behemoth Egg, and choose an appropriate §HGas Giant§! to build the orbital structure.

entries.zh: §L“抬头仰望它巨大的阴影投在卫星上。这不是一艘舰船，也不是一场风暴。而是更巨大的……活物。”《见证录，殖民地E-91》§!
entries.en: §L'We looked up and saw its shadow cross the moon. Not a ship. Not a storm. Something bigger... Something alive.' - Witness Log, Colony E-91§!

entries.zh: 部署了一枚噬天巨兽卵
在你的一个殖民地上任意可用['concept_building']槽上建造§H基因组研究所§!建筑。
entries.en: Build a §HGenomic Research Facility§! Building on one of your colonies in any available ['concept_building'] slot.

entries.zh: §L“如果我们的基因不让修改，那它们生得这么好改是作甚？”§!
entries.en: §L'If we're not supposed to modify our genome, then why is our genome so modifiable?'§!
Has built a Genomic Research Facility

entries.zh: 要在£arkship£ ['concept_arkship'] 上装备一具§H轴基挂载§!，请前往完全升级的§H方舟舰§!的 £interface£ ['concept_colony_view'] 中的§H$ARKSHIP_CONTROLS$§!选项卡。点击§H轴基挂载槽位§!，并从列表中选择§H主力舰船坞§!。
entries.en: To equip a §HSpinal Mount§! on an £arkship£ ['concept_arkship'], go to the §H$ARKSHIP_CONTROLS$§! tab of the £interface£ ['concept_colony_view'] on a fully upgraded §HArkship§!. Click on the §HSpinal Mount Slot§! and select the §HCapital Shipyard§! from the list.

entries.zh: §L“每一次航向修正、每一条轨道、每一次漂移：船坞都一一应对。”§!
entries.en: §L'Every course correction, every orbit, every drift: the shipyard works through it all.'§!

entries.zh: 选择一项焦点规划帝国的前路。\n\n变更帝国焦点的花费暂时免除。
entries.en: Select a focus to chart your empire's course.\n\nCosts to change Empire Focus are currently waived.
